title: Countdown Calculator
description: Count down to any future date and time, live, down to the second.

formula.summary: The countdown is the difference between the target date/time and the current moment, refreshed automatically every second and broken into days, hours, minutes, and seconds.

variables.meaning: The date and time you're counting down to

faqs.question: Does the countdown update automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes - once you calculate, the result refreshes every second on its own without needing to resubmit the form.

faqs.question: What time zone is used?
faqs.answer: The target date and time are interpreted in your browser's local time zone, matching what you'd see on your own device's clock.

faqs.question: What happens after the target time passes?
faqs.answer: The calculator switches to showing 'time since' the target instead of 'time remaining,' so it keeps working as an elapsed-time counter afterward.

seoContent.heading: Live countdowns for events and deadlines
seoContent.body: Whether you're counting down to a wedding, product launch, exam, or holiday, seeing the exact days, hours, minutes, and seconds remaining makes a deadline feel concrete. This calculator recalculates every second so the display always reflects the true time remaining.

seoContent.heading: How the live update works
seoContent.body: After the initial calculation, the page re-runs the same calculation once per second using the current time, rather than requiring you to refresh or resubmit - the same technique broadcast countdown clocks use, built directly into the calculator.
